title: "V2032 constraint_not_satisfied"

An error from the `type` phase. `sakura explain V2032` prints this explanation offline.

A type does not satisfy a constraint the operation requires: `Eq`, `Ord`, `Hash` or `Schema`
(`Show` is `V2031`). Functions, handlers, resources and secrets have none of them (design §4.4).

Wrong:

```sakura
let same = handler_a == handler_b
```

Fixed:

```sakura
compare the data the handlers were built from instead
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2032_constraint_not_satisfied.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V2032_constraint_not_satisfied.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
fn same() -> Bool {
  let f = fn() { 1 }
  f == f
}
```

## Fixed program

[`compiler/tests/ui/V2032_constraint_not_satisfied.fixed.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/main/compiler/tests/ui/V2032_constraint_not_satisfied.fixed.sak), which `sakura check` accepts with no diagnostics:
